record.question: In film-screen radiography, the latent image is formed by the interaction of radiation with:
options: Silver halide crystals in the film emulsion
record.explanation: Answer A: Silver halide crystals in the film emulsion. In screen-film imaging the latent image is created in silver-halide crystals in the emulsion. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
